info.name: spring-uni-api
info.description:
University Management API - full coverage.

Covers all 28 endpoints and every JPA feature that is reachable over HTTP:
- SINGLE_TABLE inheritance (courses: online / onsite)
- @ElementCollection (department contacts, PUT = full replace)
- @SecondaryTable (student profile; the student_profiles row only appears on first write)
- closed projection (GET /api/courses/summary) vs open projection (GET /api/students/display)
- soft delete: the isDeleted flag on BaseEntity and its /softDeleted endpoints
- relationships: a department lists its courses, a course lists its students, and the optional ?deleted parameter filters that NESTED list (omit it = mixed)
- MapStruct, @Version, sequences, auditing (verify these in SSMS)

Run top to bottom; folders 5 and 6 restore every flag they set, and Cleanup removes everything it created.

exec: pm.test('200 OK, not 204 - this one returns a body', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));
